neuron_or_system: s-LNv and l-LNv (LD); current rhythms persist in s-LNv but not l-LNv under DD
readout: whole-cell voltage-clamp K+ current density; firing and dynamic-clamp rescue
primary_source: Smith, P., Buhl, E., Tsaneva-Atanasova, K. & Hodge, J. J. L. Shaw and Shal voltage-gated potassium channels mediate circadian changes in Drosophila clock neuron excitability. J. Physiol. 597, 5707–5722 (2019).
claim_scope: supports Shaw current as one mechanism for LNv excitability rhythms, with cell- and lighting-condition limits
notes: The paper reports LD current rhythms in s-LNv and l-LNv; under DD the rhythm persists in s-LNv but is lost in l-LNv. neuron_or_system: larval LN(v) transcript profiling; adult s-LNv and partial l-LNv reporter; LNv-directed behavior
readout: Ir transcript rhythm; LNv-targeted RNAi/overexpression, adult locomotor behavior and PER; no native current recording
evidence_level: direct Drosophila molecular and behavioral evidence; not native electrophysiology
primary_source: Ruben, M., Drapeau, M. D., Mizrak, D. & Blau, J. A mechanism for circadian control of pacemaker neuron excitability. J. Biol. Rhythms 27, 353–364 (2012).
claim_scope: supports rhythmic Ir expression and LNv-targeted behavioral effects, but not Irk1 current or membrane-potential rhythm
